newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Kalbe Farma up on talk of acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Kalbe Farma up on talk of acquisitions.

text.p: Shares in Indonesian pharmaceutical firm PT Kalbe Farma made further gains on Tuesday on talk that either it would acquire a stake in a foreign firm or set up a new local joint venture firm, brokers said.
Kalbe Farma rose 6.45 percent, or 200 rupiah, to 3,300 rupiah on a volume close to 1.7 million shares after 120 minutes of trading. It closed 5.08 percent higher on Monday.
"Yesterday, it was rumoured one foreign firm planned to acquire a stake in Kalbe. Today, market talk has it that Kalbe plans to acquire a stake in a foreign firm," one broker said.
One analyst said the firm was likely to set up a joint venture distribution firm with a foreign partner this year and a joint venture firm to produce so-called Over-the-Counter medicines.

"There is nothing new. Investors have bought Kalbe Farma after other pharmaceutical stocks like Tempo Scan Pacific made significant gains recently," Kalbe Farma's corporate secretary Saka Abadi told Reuters.
